title: Area of rectangles, triangles and parallelograms
subtitle: Area and Perimeter · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can calculate the area of rectangles, triangles and parallelograms.

key_vocab.definition: Area is the amount of space inside a 2D shape, measured in square units (cm², m²).

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can calculate the area of rectangles, triangles and parallelograms.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Area -- Area is the amount of space inside a 2D shape, measured in square units (cm², m²).

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Always use the PERPENDICULAR height (not the slant). Triangle is half of the enclosing rectangle.
A = &frac{1}{2} × b × h
Triangle: half base times height

Key examples:
  ✓ Rectangle: A = length × width  (l × w)
  ✓ Triangle: A = &frac{1}{2} × base × height  (half of rectangle)
  ✓ Parallelogram: A = base × height  (perpendicular h)
  ✗ Triangle: A = base × height  (forgot &frac{1}{2})
  ✗ Parallelogram: use slant height  (must be perpendicular)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – rectangle
  Find the area of a rectangle 8 cm by 5 cm.
  A = l × w
  A = 8 × 5
  A = 40 cm²
  = 40 cm²
  (Multiply length by width.)

Example 2 – triangle
  Find the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm.
  A = &frac{1}{2} × b × h
  A = &frac{1}{2} × 10 × 6
  A = 30 cm²
  = 30 cm²
  (Half of base times height.)

sections.title: Area of triangles
sections.content:

(a) b = 6 cm, h = 4 cm
(b) b = 10 cm, h = 8 cm
(c) b = 14 cm, h = 5 cm
(d) b = 9 cm, h = 12 cm

sections.title: Area of parallelograms
sections.content:
Find the area. Use perpendicular height.

(a) b = 8 cm, h = 6 cm
(b) b = 11 cm, h = 4 cm
(c) b = 15 cm, h = 9 cm
(d) b = 7.5 cm, h = 8 cm

sections.title: Finding missing measurements
sections.content:
Find the missing length.

(a) Rectangle: A = 36 cm², l = 9 cm. Find w.
(b) Triangle: A = 20 cm², b = 8 cm. Find h.
(c) Parallelogram: A = 72 cm², h = 8 cm. Find b.
(d) Triangle: A = 30 cm², h = 10 cm. Find b.

sections.title: Mixed area problems
sections.content:
Calculate each area.

(a) Rectangle: 6.5 cm by 4 cm
(b) Triangle: b = 16 cm, h = 7 cm
(c) Parallelogram: b = 20 cm, h = 3.5 cm
(d) Square: side 11 cm
(e) Triangle: b = 5 cm, h = 5 cm

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ Area of a triangle = &frac{1}{2} × base × height
✗ Area of a triangle = base × height
✓ Parallelogram area uses perpendicular height
✗ Area is measured in cm
✓ A square is a special rectangle
